description: List what changed since a given time, or since the last time you asked: newly posted grades, announcements, discussion replies and inbox messages, from your activity stream. Read-only apart from remembering when you last checked, so "what's new?" works without a date.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z. Omit to use the last time this was checked (or 3 days ago the first time).

name: diff_since_last_check
title: Diff Since Last Check
